faq.metaDesc: Answers to common questions about reservations, 50% DP, and CourtGrid E-Tickets.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Direct answers to questions regarding online booking flow, 50% DP payment, and QR Code E-Ticket verification.
faq.q1: How does court reservation work on CourtGrid?
faq.a1: Select your court type, choose date and available time slot. The system will direct you to online checkout for the 50% DP. Upon confirmation, your QR E-Ticket is immediately issued in your dashboard.
faq.a2: The 50% DP system directly secures court schedules and ensures your reserved playing time is always protected.
faq.q3: How long before the slot is automatically released if DP is unpaid?
faq.a3: Reservations are automatically cancelled if the DP is unpaid within 15 minutes of creation. If you are already on the payment checkout, your slot remains safely reserved while you complete the transaction.
faq.a4: 50% DP is non-refundable if cancelled by the user. 100% refund is processed only if emergency operational cancellation occurs from venue management.
faq.q5: How do I pay the remaining 50% balance?
faq.a5: The remaining 50% payment is settled at the venue cashier before the session begins by showing the QR Code E-Ticket from the Dashboard.
faq.q6: How do I create a CourtGrid account?
faq.a6: Register with email and password, or sign in quickly via Google or Facebook. When using Google or Facebook, no separate password is required.
faq.q7: What if I forget my password?
faq.a7: Use the Forgot Password menu on the login page. A reset link is sent to your email and is temporarily valid. New requests are throttled with a 15-minute cooldown to prevent abuse.
faq.a8: Yes. Passwords are securely hashed, all connections are SSL encrypted, and payments are processed via an official gateway without our server storing card details. Full details are in the Privacy Policy.
faq.q9: Where can I see my QR E-Ticket?
faq.a9: Once the DP is verified, the E-Ticket appears in the Dashboard on the reservation detail page. Show the QR Code to the cashier at check-in.
faq.a10: The cashier scans your QR E-Ticket through the admin panel to verify the reservation before the session begins. Keep the E-Ticket on screen or printed.
faq.a11: No. Each E-Ticket has a unique reference number for one single-use session and is verified by the system directly at check-in.
faq.q12: What facilities does the venue provide?
faq.a12: The sports arena provides standard indoor futsal and badminton courts, including amenities such as waiting areas, restrooms, and lockers. Hourly pricing is available in the Court Catalog.
faq.a13: Self-cancellation is available only before DP payment is completed. Reservations with verified down payments cannot be canceled unilaterally. Please contact venue staff for special accommodations.
faq.a14: Duration is calculated precisely according to the hours stated on the E-Ticket. Late arrival does not shift your session end time.
faq.q15: How do I contact the operator?
faq.a15: Reach us at +62 877 4628 8262 / info@courtgrid.com. We respond within 1×24 business hours.

privacy.metaDesc: Terms for managing and protecting personal data of CourtGrid platform users.
privacy.title: Data Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Transparent explanation of how your personal data is collected, used, and protected by CourtGrid.
privacy.summaryItem1: We only collect data necessary for authentication and booking processes.
privacy.summaryItem2: Your transaction data is protected with industry-standard payment encryption.
privacy.summaryItem3: We never sell or share your personal information with any third parties.
privacy.s1Desc: We collect personal information in a limited and transparent manner to support authentication and court reservations on CourtGrid.
privacy.s1Item1Text: Name, email address, and profile avatar authorized via Google, Facebook, or direct registration.
privacy.s1Item2Text: Payment information is processed encrypted via an official payment gateway. Our server never stores credit card numbers.
privacy.s1Item3Text: Unique reference number used exclusively for cashier check-in verification at GOR.
privacy.s2Desc: All collected data is used exclusively for the smooth operation of the CourtGrid platform:
privacy.s2Item1: Automatically verifying account identity and arena slot availability.
privacy.s2Item2: Validating QR Code E-Tickets when checking in at venue cashiers.
privacy.s2Item3: Sending DP payment receipts and official booking proof via email.
privacy.s3Desc: We implement industry-standard technical protection to guarantee the confidentiality of personal user data.
privacy.s3Item1: Data transmission is fully encrypted with secure HTTPS protocols.
privacy.s3Item2: We never sell, trade, or share personal data with any commercial third party.
privacy.s4Desc: We use session cookies to keep you signed in and prevent authentication abuse:
privacy.s4Item1: Authentication cookies for login session, required to maintain signed-in status.
privacy.s4Item2: Language and theme preference cookies for a consistent experience.
privacy.s4Item3: We do not use cross-site tracking or third-party ads that read your personal data.
privacy.s5Title: 5. Your Rights Under PDP Law No. 27 of 2022
privacy.s5Desc: Under the Personal Data Protection Law, you have the right to:
privacy.s5Item1: Access: request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s5Item2: Rectification: update or correct inaccurate data.
privacy.s5Item3: Erasure and restriction: request account and related data deletion, as applicable.
privacy.s6Desc: Data is kept as long as needed for service and legal compliance:
privacy.s6Item1: Account data is kept while the account is active; account deletion removes or anonymizes personal data within permitted timeframes.
privacy.s6Item2: Transaction records are retained for audit and tax purposes in line with applicable regulations.
privacy.s6Item3: Data is processed on cloud infrastructure and payment gateway providers adhering to rigorous data protection standards.
privacy.s7Desc: For questions or personal data rights requests, contact info@courtgrid.com. We respond within 14 business days.
